name: Arjun Sharma
content: Owais consistently delivers clean, well-documented Node.js code. His ability to optimise MongoDB queries and reduce latency across our APIs has been a real asset to the team. He brings both technical depth and a collaborative spirit.

name: Priya Nair
content: What stands out about Owais is his ownership. He doesn't just implement tickets — he asks the right questions, flags edge cases early, and always thinks about the user experience. It makes the whole development process smoother.

content: I hired Owais to build my business website and he delivered beyond expectations. Not only was the site exactly what I envisioned, but he also explained every decision clearly. Communication was excellent throughout.
